facts.fact: PMMVY now runs as PMMVY 2.0 under Mission Shakti (from 1.4.2022)
facts.quote: The norm of PMMVY 2.0 under Mission Shakti will be applicable with effect from 01.04. 2022.

facts.fact: First child: Rs 5,000 in two instalments (Rs 3,000 after ANC, Rs 2,000 after childbirth and 14 weeks of immunisation)
facts.quote: The PMMVY benefit of Rs 5000/- is given for the first child in two instalments (first instalment of ₹3000/- after Ante-Natal Check-up (ANC) and second instalment of ₹2000/- after the childbirth and 14 weeks of universal immunization).

facts.fact: Mission Shakti guidelines: the Rs 3,000 first instalment is paid on registration of pregnancy and at least one ANC within 6 months of LMP
facts.quote: On registration of pregnancy and at least one Ante-natal Instalment check-up within 6 months from LMP date at the

facts.fact: The portal FAQ table instead says registration of pregnancy and at least two ANC, preferably within six months of LMP
facts.quote: Registration/First Instalment Registration of Pregnancy and at least two Ante-Natal Check-up (ANC) preferably within six months from LMP

facts.fact: The Rs 2,000 second instalment is paid after the birth is registered and the child completes the first cycle of immunisation (14 weeks)
facts.quote: Second Instalment The birth of the child is registered. Child has completed first cycle of immunization (14 weeks) ₹,2000

facts.fact: Second child: Rs 6,000 in a single instalment after birth, only if the second child is a girl
facts.quote: Rs. 6000/- is given for the second child (if girl child) in a single instalment after the childbirth and completion of universal immunization within 14 weeks.

facts.fact: The second-girl-child benefit applies from 1 April 2022
facts.quote: Now, with effect from 1.4.2022, PMMVY benefits are given for the second child also, if the second child is a girl.

facts.fact: The beneficiary can also get Janani Suraksha Yojana benefit after an institutional delivery
facts.quote: In addition to the above, the beneficiary is also eligible to get the benefit of Janani Suraksha Yojana (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Scheme) after institutional delivery.

facts.fact: Eligible women include SC/ST women, women with 40% or more disability, BPL ration card holders, PM-JAY beneficiaries and e-Shram card holders
facts.quote: Women belonging to scheduled castes and scheduled tribes Women who are partially (40%) or fully disabled (Divyang Jan) Women holder of BPL ration Card Women Beneficiaries under Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana (PMJAY) under Ayushman Bharat Women holding E-shram card

facts.fact: Also eligible: PM-KISAN women farmers, MGNREGA job card holders, women with net family income below Rs 8 lakh a year, pregnant/lactating AWWs/AWHs/ASHAs and NFSA ration card holders
facts.quote: Women farmers who are beneficiaries under Kisan Samman Nidhi Women holding MGNREGA Job Card Women whose net family income is less than ₹8 Lakh per annum Pregnant and Lactating AWWs/ AWHs/ ASHAs Women holding Ration Card under NFSA Act 2013

facts.fact: The husband's Aadhaar is no longer required
facts.quote: The mandatory provision of the husband’s Aadhaar has been removed.

summary: PMMVY FAQ and Mission Shakti guidelines confirm all amounts, conditions and eligibility; the one-vs-two ANC difference the answer notes is still there. No 2026-27 guideline revision found.
